{{Quote|The ''Mandallian Giant'' is just ''mean!''|Bardron|<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" />}}
In [[3963 BBY]], this '''Mandallian Giant''' competed in the final round of the [[Tandem Open]]. Wearing gold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plates and a purple loincloth, they rode a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]] large enough to accommodate their size. They attempted to attack [[Aubin Kleej]] and [[Zayne Carrick]], but Kleej's [[Goethar Kleej|father]] leapt into the fray and dispatched the [[Mandallian Giant]] in order to protect Aubin.
